subject: Observability handoff & implementation — dashboards, traces, runbooks
messages:
From: Erin Smith <erin@northbayhealth.com>
To: markus_klein <markus@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Observability handoff & implementation kickoff

Hi Markus / Marissa,

Thanks for taking this on. As discussed in last week's exec call, Northbay is ready to move from PoC to production for our Redwood integration. We want a tight handoff so our SREs and dev teams have clear ownership of dashboards, traces, and alert routing. High-level asks: 

- Dashboard baseline: latency, p95/p99 token cost, per-model throughput, error rates by endpoint
- Tracing hooks: recommended span points (request entry, model decode, cache lookup, fallback routing) and example instrumentation snippets
- Error taxonomy & routing: what counts as retryable vs paging, and alert destinations (SRE Slack, on-call pager)
- Runbooks: a short-runbook for common incidents + escalation ladder

We have a tight go-live target: calendar week of Jun 22. Can we get an implementation plan and owners by EOD Thu (June 11)? I've attached a current internal MAP and the list of stakeholders.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth handoff.

— Erin
Erin Smith
Director of Platform Ops, Northbay Health

(Attachment: northbay-implementation-MAP.xlsx)

From: markus_klein <markus@redwood.ai>
To: Erin Smith <erin@northbayhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability handoff & implementation kickoff

Erin — great summary, thanks.

Quick plan attached and owners called out. TL;DR: we can meet target if we split work across three parallel tracks this week: 

1) Dashboards & metrics (owner: Marissa) — baseline panels + alerts for service-level regressions. Deliverable: Grafana folder + alert rules by Jun 18.
2) Tracing hooks & snippets (owner: Ben) — minimal span set and example instrumentation in Northbay's language (Python + Go). Deliverable: code snippets and tracing checklist by Jun 16.
3) Runbooks & error taxonomy (owner: Laura) — concise runbooks (pager, mitigation steps, rollback) and mapping to alert severity. Deliverable: runbook drafts by Jun 11 (per your ask).

I've attached: runbook_template_v2.md, dashboard_mocks.pdf, and a short file with tracing_hook_snippets.txt. We'll also drop a shared Drive folder and a HubSpot playbook link.

Next steps:
- Marissa, Ben, Laura — can you confirm the deliverable dates inline?
- Erin & Sunil — confirm who on your side will take first-response ownership for paging during week of Jun 22 (SRE1 or SRE2?).

If everyone agrees, I'll schedule a 30-min sync Thur (Jun 11) at 10am PT to lock the plan.

Thanks,
— Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: runbook_template_v2.md; dashboard_mocks.pdf; tracing_hook_snippets.txt)

On Tue, 9 Jun 2026 at 09:12 Erin Smith <erin@northbayhealth.com> wrote:
> Thanks for taking this on. As discussed in last week's exec call, Northbay is ready to move from PoC to production for our Redwood integration. ...

From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: markus_klein <markus@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Cc: Erin Smith <erin@northbayhealth.com>, Sunil Rao <sunil@northbayhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 08:29:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability handoff & implementation kickoff

Markus / team — I can take the dashboard track. Quick clarifications and risks: 

- Data sources: we'll rely on both service metrics (Redwood agent) and application metrics (Northbay API). Need Sunil to share metric names for request types and model variants (e.g., /generate-chat vs /embeddings).
- Alert routing: propose a three-tier model — info (Slack channel), action-needed (SRE on-call), critical (pager + exec alert). We should map alerts in the runbook so CS can triage before paging.
- Dashboards: I will deliver two dashboards: Ops (latency, throughput, token counts) and Quality (model-level error types, rerate by prompt set). Mockups attached.

Deliverables and dates (confirming Markus):
- Dashboard folder + alert rule drafts — Jun 18
- Dashboard handoff walkthrough (30m) — Jun 19

Ben — can you push the tracing snippets for cache-hit vs fallback spans by Jun 16? I want to link those spans into the dashboard-based trace links so our SREs can jump to traces from the panels.

Laura — I'll lean on you to draft the initial error taxonomy (retryable, degrade, urgent) and put the first-runbook draft in the shared Drive (target Jun 11).

Thanks — I will book the Thur 10am sync if Markus confirms.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Product Manager, Observability — Redwood Inference

Team — this is great, and thanks for the clear owners. Quick confirmations from our side: 

- First-response: Sunil Rao (SRE1) will take pager ownership for the week of Jun 22. He'll be copied into the runbook doc.
- Metric names: Sunil will drop a short list today of the metric names and tagging conventions.
- On-call window: we will do a staggered validation Tue/Thu during that week and keep the pager thin (one SRE).

I confirm the deliverable dates above. Please proceed and include a 1-2 sentence runbook summary in the runbook file header so our engineers can quickly scan. If anything slips we can push go-live by one week but prefer to keep Jun 22.

I'll see you on Thu 10am PT.

— Erin
Erin Smith
Director of Platform Ops, Northbay Health
